scientific_boundary: Field coverage alone cannot prove a 70 eV source spectrum, EI instrument, authentic standard, or independent acquisition.
Sample name, collision-energy and license metadata are not trustworthy acquisition grouping keys unless accession/experiment lineage is documented.
The underlying old MS-DIAL 28,220 spectra aggregate public libraries and exact duplicates; independence needs publisher-level origin and true instrument run identifiers.
All retained EI query and reference spectral *inputs* were already accessed in source forensics; sealed model correctness and ranking outcomes were not.
This provenance field inventory does not claim 5% or 10% selective risk, conformal coverage or production fitness.
